How Much Mulch Do I Need?

The amount of mulch you need depends on the size of your garden beds and the depth you want to apply. Here's how to figure it out quickly.

🧮

Mulch Calculator — get your exact bag and cubic yard count

Enter your exact dimensions for a personalized estimate →
## The quick formula **Mulch needed (cu yd) = Length (ft) × Width (ft) × Depth (in) ÷ 324** Then multiply by 13.5 to convert cubic yards to 2 cu ft bags. ## Step-by-step: how to measure your beds 1. **Measure each bed** — Walk the perimeter with a tape measure. Record length and width in feet. For curved beds, break them into rough rectangles. 2. **Add up your areas** — For multiple beds, measure each one separately and add them together. 3. **Choose a depth** — 2–3 inches is standard for existing beds; 3–4 inches for new beds. 4. **Plug into the formula** — Or use the [Mulch Calculator](/calculator/mulch) to get bags and cubic yards instantly. ## Coverage table — how far does 1 cubic yard go? | Depth | Coverage per cubic yard | |-------|------------------------| | 1 inch | 324 sq ft | | 2 inches | 162 sq ft | | 3 inches | 108 sq ft | | 4 inches | 81 sq ft | | 6 inches | 54 sq ft | *1 cubic yard = 13.5 bags (2 cu ft each)* ## Coverage per bag (2 cu ft bag) | Depth | Coverage per bag | |-------|-----------------| | 1 inch | 24 sq ft | | 2 inches | 12 sq ft | | 3 inches | 8 sq ft | | 4 inches | 6 sq ft | ## How much to buy: quick examples | Bed size | At 2" depth | At 3" depth | |----------|-------------|-------------| | 5 × 10 ft | 4 bags | 6 bags | | 10 × 10 ft | 7 bags | 10 bags | | 10 × 20 ft | 13 bags | 19 bags | | 20 × 20 ft | 25 bags | 38 bags | *Rounded up. Assumes no waste factor — add 5–10% for irregular shapes.* ## Bags vs. bulk: which should you buy? - **Under 1 cubic yard (13 bags):** bags from a garden center are usually more convenient. - **1–3 cubic yards:** compare bag cost vs. bulk delivery — bulk often wins above 1.5 yards. - **Over 3 cubic yards:** bulk delivery is almost always cheaper and less work. ## How much does mulch cost? Bagged mulch typically runs **$4–$8 per 2 cu ft bag** at big-box stores. Bulk delivery varies by region: **$25–$60 per cubic yard** is typical. Frequently Asked Questions

How many bags of mulch do I need for a 10×10 garden bed?

A 10×10 ft bed (100 sq ft) at 3 inches deep needs about 0.93 cubic yards or 13 bags (2 cu ft each), before adding a waste factor. Round up to 14 bags to be safe.

How deep should I apply mulch?

Apply 2–3 inches for existing beds that already have some mulch, or 3–4 inches for new beds or areas where weed suppression is a priority. Avoid piling mulch against plant stems.

How much does a bag of mulch cover?

A standard 2 cubic foot bag covers 24 sq ft at 1 inch deep, 12 sq ft at 2 inches, or 8 sq ft at 3 inches.

How many bags of mulch are in a cubic yard?

There are 13.5 bags (2 cu ft each) in one cubic yard. If you need more than 2–3 cubic yards, bulk delivery is usually cheaper.

Should I buy bags or bulk mulch?

Bags are convenient for small areas (under 1–2 cubic yards) or where a truck cannot access. Bulk delivery is significantly cheaper per cubic yard for larger projects.
